turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so I'll be direct: why is there a zero on my son's essay, and who decided it?
I should have called you before entering the zero. I didn't, and I'm sorry.
Okay. Who decided it, Hale, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
The essay quotes a line, 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile', that isn't anywhere in Hamlet.
I'm writing that down. Show me the page it's on, Hale. A line that isn't in the play is one line, and I want to see where it sits in his essay before it justifies a zero.
And look, I know Claire had a case here too. It seems to run in the family.
You'll want to be very careful about the next sentence, Hale. My daughter's case was decided in her favour, and it has nothing to do with Owen's essay. Say that again in front of the principal.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require the zero withdrawn and written confirmation that nothing goes on Owen's record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position, with the zero still standing and nothing agreed.
What moved her: nothing.
